source: Dalsgaard et al. 2018 Antillean hummingbird networks

next_route: Use an independent lawful public mirror/author artifact if recovered, or retain the Caribbean fourth-stratum gate closed. Do not reconstruct matrices from article summaries and do not relax the preregistered raw-network requirement.
